source_text: Blood-fed adult female An. funestus mosquitoes resting indoors were collected in houses between 06:00 and 10:00 h using electric aspirators from the rural area of Kpome (6°23'N, 2°13'E) a southern inland region of Benin from December 2013 to February 2014.
